episodeTitle.en: The art and wisdom of changing teams | Heidi Helfand (Author of Dynamic Reteaming)
episodeTitle.zh: 团队变动的艺术与智慧 | 海蒂·赫尔方德（《动态团队重组》作者）

guestBioOfficial.en: Heidi Helfand is the author of Dynamic Reteaming, which outlines practical strategies for orchestrating successful team and company org changes. Her work is informed by more than 20 years in the tech industry at notable companies like AppFolio, Procore, and Expertcity/GoToMeeting. Today, she dedicates her efforts to sharing her knowledge through workshops, comprehensive courses, and consultative services, helping organizations navigate and optimize their team structures. In this episode, we discuss: • The importance of reteaming and reorging
guestBioOfficial.zh: 海蒂·赫尔方德是《动态团队重组》一书的作者，该书概述了成功进行团队和公司组织变革的实用策略。她在科技行业拥有超过20年的经验，曾就职于AppFolio、Procore和Expertcity/GoToMeeting等知名公司。如今，她致力于通过工作坊、综合课程和咨询服务分享知识，帮助组织优化团队结构。在本期节目中，我们讨论了：• 团队和组织变动的重要性

title.en: The art and wisdom of changing teams | Heidi Helfand (Author of Dynamic Reteaming)
title.zh: 团队变动的艺术与智慧 | 海蒂·赫尔方德（《动态团队重组》作者）

summary.en: Heidi argues that constantly stable teams aren't actually best—dynamic reteaming reduces attrition, stagnation, and knowledge silos—and lays out the five types of reteaming plus the anti-patterns to avoid when reorganizing. She covers what team structure is most conducive to creating brand-new products, why being transparent about reorg plans is worth it, and how she herself became such a remarkably good listener. It's a practical guide to the 'people layer' of building software that most leaders neglect.
summary.zh: Heidi 主张“永远稳定的团队”并非最好——动态重组（dynamic reteaming）能降低流失、停滞与知识孤岛，并梳理了五种重组类型，以及在重组时应避免的反模式。她谈到了哪种团队结构最有利于从零打造新产品、为何把重组计划透明化是值得的，以及她自己是如何成为如此出色的倾听者的。这期节目是关于“做软件时的人”这一被多数领导者忽视的层面的实用指南。
